name: torizon-app-hub
description: Portable Torizon App Hub discovery and local bundle workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Discover apps and build local Torizon bundles.
interface.longDescription: Use portable App Hub Skills for public discovery and local bundle workflows. The plugin configures the App Hub MCP server; delegated OAuth is still required before private App Hub access is available.
defaultPrompt: Find a Torizon App Hub application for my project.
Compare App Hub applications for my hardware.
Build and validate a local App Hub bundle.
